acceptance_requirements: Every retained score and immutable source/environment/file binding.
Reproduce unchanged rigid and original direct/table/pooled/naive forecasts at rate one.
Independently regenerate every replacement, context and coherent bundle; check rate posterior and all scalar learned probabilities.
Average fits within worlds; report every native-to-shift change at each contamination rate and current duplicate-removal control.
Complete source-frozen native-context family replay, after all four original blocks.
calibration: Reuse B02 procedure: choose 0.25/0.5/1 by clean validation laws averaged over registered copying rates. No contaminated development labels or rate tuning.
continuation: Evaluate learned persistence before prioritizing A04/C06/E02/E03 within remaining measured budget. No repeated valid NB grid or reserved confirmation exposure.
criteria: Descriptive paired loss/Brier and rate-detection contrasts against rigid, context-only and the strongest retained rival. Stop personalization scale-up if unrelated content helps equally or inferred protection fails; no superiority promotion from a contaminated cell without new exact-law headroom and matched refit convergence.
design: Current cases, all historical contexts and historical episode count remain fixed. A common random mask replaces episode content using an independent uniform maker conditional on each original context; the shuffled-author bundle uses one foreign maker. Native/changed blocks have paired worlds but their original case samples differ. Both current and historical execution change in these upstream cells.
learned_model: Same clean-label 32-state 40-step unsupervised fit. Each conditional episode factor mixes its learned state likelihood with learned population content conditional on context, preserving the state context likelihood. A uniform prior over four registered rates is marginalized before normalization; current observations inform the rate posterior. Unseen episode mass is allocated uniformly over eight contexts.
limitations: Frozen clean-data parameters do not establish contamination-refitted convergence.
Latent capacity and fixed-step fit remain distinct from validation-stopped direct.
Foreign coherent bundles violate the independent-episode contamination model.
Context-only history is not no history.
Unchanged supplied-law B03 repair allowance is already consumed; this extension receives no additional repair.
privileges: Current exact target support shared by every arm.
Only supplied-rate receives the generating replacement probability; no reader receives generator maker identity.
Original contexts themselves retain maker information even when all other historical content is foreign.
question: Do the two shifted candidates that survive generic tempering retain useful personalization while rejecting unrelated episode content?
selection: Previously reported context and complete-evidence shifted candidates, 512 labels, plus their native companions. The artifact candidate failed the generic-tempering discriminator and is excluded before new outcomes.
